title: Airbnb vs Vrbo Revenue Mix
dataSources: Airbnb bookings (`airbnb:booking`), Vrbo reservations (`vrbo:reservation`), Airbnb payouts (`airbnb:payout`), and guest reviews (`guest:review`).
app: Airbnb booking exports, Vrbo reservation webhooks, Airbnb payout statements, guest review logs, and turnover checklists streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=airbnb:booking nightly_rate_usd=* stay_nights=*) OR (index=personal sourcetype=vrbo:reservation total_usd=*)
| eval revenue=coalesce(nightly_rate_usd*stay_nights,total_usd)
| bin _time span=1q
| stats sum(revenue) as quarterly_revenue by _time platform=case(sourcetype="airbnb:booking","Airbnb",sourcetype="vrbo:reservation","Vrbo",1=1,"Other")
| chart sum(quarterly_revenue) over _time by platform
description: Compares quarterly rental revenue between Airbnb and Vrbo channels.
value: Channel mix shows whether diversification is real or whether one platform carries all your income risk.
implementation: Normalize revenue from both booking feeds and review the quarterly split before renewing channel subscriptions.
visualization: Stacked column chart of revenue by platform and quarter.
grandmaExplanation: It spots how much rental income came from Airbnb versus Vrbo each quarter.
